The '''inside-outside room''' was part of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa's]] private quarters in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]]. One entire wall of that room was made of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] doors that provided a full view of the family's private gardens. In the early days of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the members of the royal family would often gather in that room in the mornings and evenings to watch the sunset. The name "inside-outside room" had been invented by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Prince/Legends|Crown Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], when she was a [[Youngling/Legends|child]].<ref name="LJMoD" />
